git diff --check && git diff --stat && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
before = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:ops/devlane/task/jobs.json']))
after = json.loads(Path('ops/devlane/task/jobs.json').read_text())
changed = []
for name, job in before.items():
    expected = dict(job)
    if job.get('adapter') == 'harness' and '{inputs}' not in job['prompt']:
        expected['prompt'] = job['prompt'].replace('Inputs named by the brief', 'Inputs: {inputs}\nInputs named by the brief')
        changed.append(name)
    assert after[name] == expected, name
assert before.keys() == after.keys()
assert len(changed) == 6
print('Only input-list additions:', ', '.join(changed))
PY
